meta.title: EREBUS — The Gift Shop
meta.note: Galactic gift shop for celestial beings. Door lives in The Relics. Products ship on transparent backgrounds so they float.

stops.eyebrow: Trading post at the rim of the dark
stops.title: The Gift Shop
stops.body: Nothing in Erebus is manufactured. Things are cultivated, fruit once, and are let go. What floats here is for sale. What has stopped floating already found its owner.

stops.title: What grows on these shelves
stops.body: Wearables that remember the dark. Prints pulled straight off the walls of rooms you have already walked. Objects with no listed function — celestial beings rarely need one. Stock arrives the way mushrooms do: several at once, then nothing for a season. Checkout happens here. You never leave the dark to pay.
